Priya Rao: Heads-up — quick sync on validation UI for the compact Settings modal. We have three competing constraints: small vertical space, discoverability of errors, and screen reader behavior. Draft options: (A) compact-inline: reserve a 20px slot under each field for message height, show errors on blur; (B) summary-bar: top banner with links to fields after submit; (C) hybrid: inline but collapse to a summary bar when viewport height < 520px. Thoughts? Elliot Marsh: I prefer hybrid. On desktop inline is clear. On very short modals the banner prevents CTAs from jumping around. The key is to keep a consistent mapping from server error keys to field anchors so the banner links are reliable. Carmen Diaz: Hybrid sounds good. Accessibility note: whichever pattern, when errors appear we need to move logical focus and provide an SR announcement. For inline: role=alert on the message. For banner: focus the banner (tabindex=-1) and use aria-live to announce "3 errors found". Owen Brooks: Implementation detail: our error payload uses dotted paths (e.g., "integration.api_key"). We'll add data-field-id attributes that mirror those paths so anchors like #integration-api_key work. Also we should avoid layout shifts: animate opacity only and keep reserved space for messages as Priya suggested. Priya Rao: Copy suggestions: inline message example "API key is required"; banner title "2 problems prevent saving" with each list item like "API key Fix" linking to the field. Keep microcopy direct and actionable. Elliot Marsh: For required markers: asterisk alone is ambiguous for SR. Proposal: visually show an asterisk but include hidden text for SR: Required. On mobile we can show small inline hint text for the first field in a group and hide subsequent repeats. Carmen Diaz: ARIA snippet I recommend reusing:
API key is required
Also ensure the banner uses role="region" aria-labelledby for the heading. Owen Brooks: Destructives: for deleting an integration from the compact modal, I suggest modal + checkbox for quick operations, typed-confirm for anything that triggers billing or cascade deletes. When typed-confirm is required, make it forgiving: case-insensitive and trim spaces. Provide explicit hint: "Type REMOVE to confirm." Priya Rao: Agreed. Also add undo toast for soft deletes. For hard deletes, typed confirm plus clear consequences in the message. Elliot Marsh: Small UX nit: for inline errors on mobile, if the keyboard covers the field, scroll the field into view and keep the error visible above keyboard using a small offset. Carmen Diaz: Accessibility checklist from me: 1) focus management to either banner or first field; 2) role=alert for inline; 3) banner uses aria-live polite and receives focus; 4) required markers readable by SR; 5) keyboard-only flow tested. Priya Rao: Proposed decision: adopt hybrid pattern (inline-by-default, collapse-to-banner under narrow heights), reserve space for inline hints to avoid shift, SR-friendly required markers, typed-confirm for high-risk destructive actions, modal+undo for others. I'll update the Patterns doc and drop Figma variants for compact modal. Anyone object? Owen Brooks: None. I'll add server-client id mapping to the API spec. Elliot Marsh: Fine. I'll add the keyboard + VoiceOver acceptance test to the QA checklist. Carmen Diaz: I'll log an accessibility follow-up ticket and paste the ARIA snippets into the spec. A11y (bot): Follow-up created: A11Y-4999. Checklist appended to the design doc. Priya Rao: Thanks all — will post mocks and the updated spec later today. End thread.
